_comment: Copy to .claude/settings.json to enable. Kept as an example rather than
enabled by default because a hook changes how every session in this
repository behaves, and that is a decision for whoever works here rather
than for whoever wrote the hook.
Set QM_ROUTES_STRICT=1 in the environment to make it refuse rather than
warn. Start with warn: a hook that blocks something legitimate at a bad
moment gets switched off, and a switched-off hook is worse than none.
